dataset: UAE Insurance Ecosystem Explorer sector taxonomy
source_note: Curated from the repository's 19 dedicated sector explorer pages. This is a conceptual navigation taxonomy, not an official exhaustive UAE insurance classification. Sector roles and journeys describe generic workflows unless separately supported by claim-level evidence.

sectors.overview_en: Health cover connects members to insurers, healthcare providers, health administrators and emirate-specific health infrastructure.
sectors.overview_ar: يربط التأمين الصحي العضو بشركات التأمين ومقدمي الرعاية ومديري المطالبات والبنية الصحية الخاصة بكل إمارة.
